01 — FAIL: meta refresh present with a positive delay

Unlike the A-level meta-refresh-timing-absent rule (which allows a long exempt delay), this AAA-level rule flags any positive-delay meta refresh with no exemption. A delay="0" immediate redirect still passes at AAA (see this rule's inline unit tests) -- there is nothing for a user to be interrupted mid-read by. This is a whole-document check, so only one scenario is demonstrated here; the notApplicable case (no meta refresh tag at all) is covered by the inline unit tests in this rule's .test.js file.
